card.name: Spaces and colons before section labels
card.fires_on: Spaces or punctuation (colon, period, semicolon) that sit right before a new heading, subsection number or list item in drug-label text. Most often the space after a section number like 2. that comes before the next digit.

modes.label: Space after section number
modes.description: The space following a number-dot such as 2. just before the subsection digit.

modes.label: Colon after a label
modes.description: A colon after a drug or treatment-phase name that introduces the next item.

modes.label: Sentence-end punctuation before a heading
modes.description: A period, comma or semicolon that ends a clause just before a new heading or list entry.
